description: The AWS::Neptune::DBClusterParameterGroup resource creates a new Amazon Neptune DB cluster parameter group. Source:- https://github.com/aws-cloudformation/aws-cloudformation-resource-providers-neptune

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The key name of the tag. You can specify a value that is 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.

Value.description: The value for the tag. You can specify a value that is 0 to 256 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.

Tag.title: AWSNeptuneDBClusterParameterGroupTagDefinition

Description.description: Provides the customer-specified description for this DB cluster parameter group.

Family.description: Must be neptune1 for engine versions prior to 1.2.0.0, or neptune1.2 for engine version 1.2.0.0 and higher.

Parameters.description: An array of parameters to be modified. A maximum of 20 parameters can be modified in a single request.

Name.description: Provides the name of the DB cluster parameter group.

Tags.description: The list of tags for the cluster parameter group.
